summary: Iteration 2 DEEP frontend E2E of CROS. All 3 regression fixes VERIFIED: (1) idempotent replay returns same request_id (confirmed by main agent via curl), (2) safety_critic LLM outputs now show critic.mode='llm_plus_guardrail' (or hard_guardrail on blocked) with no length-caused fallback — 13/13 recommendations on AI tab used LLM critic, (3) websocket /api/v1/realtime no longer emits initial 403. Commander approve → mission → dispatch flow works. Full responder mission lifecycle (dispatched → accepted_by_responder → en_route → on_scene → completed) drove correctly with cloud confirmation and history growth. Citizen offline round trip (toggle offline → NEED RESCUE → SAVED LOCALLY + [QUEUED_1] → toggle online → SYNC NOW → [SYNCED], queued row cleared and request materialized as CORROBORATED in MY REQUESTS) works. Medical CRDT inc/dec of occupied_beds updates BEDS free and shows CRDT op id in facility-note; RUN MATCH returned 2 ranked matches. Shelter occupancy inc/dec updates % utilization. Comms internet+cellular fail flips connectivity to SATELLITE_BACKHAUL, probe queues a message, flush delivers it, restore returns state to CONNECTED. Gateway sync updates LOCAL EVENTS/PROJECTIONS/CACHED DEVICES/LAST SYNC counters (0→25/25/15/1s ago). Analyst misinformation run created simulation and RESILIENCE run row (7 rows). Role guards: citizen→/command redirects to /citizen, responder→/admin redirects to /responder — both PASS. ADMIN PAGE IS BROKEN: /api/v1/organizations returns 403 for system_administrator causing the whole Admin console to stay stuck on LOADING ADMIN CONSOLE (Promise.all rejects, users state never set). /api/v1/command-center is also 403 for admin, spamming the console with 403s on every poll.

critical.issue: Returns 403 to system_administrator (baigmuzammil62@gmail.com). This breaks the entire Admin console (Admin.jsx does Promise.all([/users,/devices,/organizations,/system/health,/audit]) so a single 403 rejects the whole promise and the users state is never populated → page is stuck on 'LOADING ADMIN CONSOLE' indefinitely. USERS(200)/DEVICES(200)/AUDIT(200)/SYSTEM/HEALTH(200) are all fine.
Returns 403 to system_administrator. The Shell polls this endpoint continuously from /admin, spamming the browser console with 403 errors every few seconds.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses Promise.all across 5 endpoints so any single 403 stalls the whole page on Loader. Should tolerate a failing sub-fetch (Promise.allSettled) and surface partial data + an error note via admin-note.

issues: Horizontal overflow: document scrollWidth=720px (citizen) and 692px (responder) versus 390px clientWidth. The Shell top-bar badge row ([CONNECTED][RT_CONNECTED][SYNCED][SAT_SIMULATED][SYNC] + user + EXIT) does not wrap and pushes body wider than viewport, forcing horizontal scroll on mobile. Cards themselves lay out fine, but the header must wrap / use flex-wrap or be collapsed into a menu on <sm.

action_items: Fix RBAC: grant system_administrator (or a distinct 'admin_console' permission) read access to GET /api/v1/organizations and GET /api/v1/command-center — currently both return 403 for the seeded admin, which entirely blocks the /admin page from rendering.
Harden Admin.jsx load() to use Promise.allSettled so partial failures render available panels (users, devices, audit, health) with an inline error, instead of getting stuck on the Loader forever.
Fix mobile top-bar wrapping in Shell.jsx: the badge row + user + EXIT should flex-wrap or collapse at sm-breakpoint. Both /citizen and /responder overflow horizontally at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx (line 16-27): Promise.all is not resilient — one 403 breaks the whole console. Prefer Promise.allSettled with per-fetch error handling.

Auth policy inconsistency: system_administrator can read /users, /devices, /audit, /system/health but NOT /organizations or /command-center. Either give the admin role a supersets read permission, or explicitly document the split and remove /organizations from Admin.jsx.
Shell top-bar responsive: 6+ badges + role label + EXIT in a single non-wrapping row overflows 390px viewport for citizen/responder personas.

success_rate.backend: 5/6 admin endpoints (users, devices, audit, system/health OK; organizations + command-center 403 for admin)

Admin page is the only failing flow (stuck on Loader). Mobile has horizontal overflow issue on /citizen and /responder.

admin_page_stuck_loading.reproduction: Log in as baigmuzammil62@gmail.com / CrosAdmin!2026 → land on /admin → page shows '[///...] LOADING ADMIN CONSOLE' forever. Browser network shows repeated 403s on GET /api/v1/organizations and GET /api/v1/command-center; the other admin GETs (/users, /devices, /audit, /system/health) return 200.
admin_page_stuck_loading.root_cause: Two layered defects. (a) Backend RBAC: the system_administrator role is not granted read on the organizations router nor on the command-center aggregate router — those endpoints reject with 403. (b) Frontend Admin.jsx uses Promise.all() across all 5 endpoints — because one leg rejects, the .then() branch never runs, the `users` state stays null, and `if (!users) return <Loader/>` shows the loader forever with no error message to the user.
admin_page_stuck_loading.mitigation: Backend: add organizations:read (and whatever gates /command-center) to the system_administrator role, OR remove the /organizations call from Admin.jsx and lazy-load it only when the ORG panel is opened. Frontend: switch to Promise.allSettled so partial data renders and failed fetches surface via the existing admin-note toast.
